title: GeneCS: Synthesizing Resource-Efficient Code Surgery for Arbitrary Quantum Stabilizer Codes
summary: Efficiently realizing logical operations on general stabilizer codes remains a long-standing challenge in fault tolerant quantum computing. While code surgery provides a general framework with provable guarantees by joint logical measurements, existing constructions are largely theoretical and incur substantial ancilla overhead in practice. In this work, we propose GeneCS, a resource-efficient compiler for synthesizing code surgery protocols for arbitrary stabilizer codes.
